node: Franchise-owned or franchisor-controlled commissary, ingredient manufacturing, and distribution networks
summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around the underappreciated restaurant supply-chain node where scale procurement, commissary production, food manufacturing, and distribution can improve franchisee economics. Domino's is the reference model because its supply-chain infrastructure is explicitly tied to franchisee ingredient sourcing and distribution. Yum Brands is a large-cap reference anchor because it is reportedly consolidating supply-chain operations across franchise systems. The underfollowed discovery lane points to B2B/private-label coffee and foodservice suppliers such as Farmer Brothers and Westrock Coffee, where restaurant exposure may be hidden inside wholesale, foodservice, private-label, or direct-store-delivery relationships rather than obvious restaurant-brand revenue.
